scope: Prospective methods extension after Gemini critique; old six targets remain exploratory. New stereo targets are quality-selected before v5 Earth rankings and are not evidence of operational rehearsal utility.

mask.source: ESA WorldCover 2021 v200 classes40/50 plus current OSM highways and landuse farmland/industrial/quarry/construction/landfill
mask.required_unknown_handling: Missing WorldCover coverage excluded; OSM absence never called verified natural land
mask.timing: Apply source mask before Gaussian smoothing/derivatives. Source epochs differ; no causal claim about historical DEM flattening.

eligibility.interpretation: Availability-only prefilter changes the v5 search population; images may still be used for frozen morphology observations, never as numerical colour similarity.

declustering.order: robust loss, nominal loss, stable candidate ID

new_targets.selection_uses: metadata geometry and local validity only; no Earth matching or morphology outcome
new_targets.fine_source_limit: CTX stereo is MOLA-aligned; Copernicus DSM can contain SRTM auxiliary fill, so independence is limited and recorded.

controls.policy: One nomination and one seeded lower-ranked, same-region, nonoverlapping control with fixed matching tolerances; unfilled controls remain explicit
controls.rejected_gemini_rank_band: Ranks30-100 may not exist after context declustering; no impossible rank-band guarantee

statistics.unit: One frozen planetary target, conditional on a complete nomination/control pair
statistics.primary: Descriptive paired differences in normalized joint slope/curvature Wasserstein distance and hypsometric integral difference
statistics.significance: Report exact paired sign/randomization test when enough independent target units exist; five of six wins alone is not p<.05. No independence inferred from window count.

contact_reference.global_map: SIM3292 scale1:20000000 is context only, not 200m contact ground truth
contact_reference.fine_reference_required: Published fine-scale contact with defensible positional accuracy or separately authored blinded expert annotation
contact_reference.no_reference: No boundary F1 or rehearsal-utility claim without an appropriate actual reference

forbidden_claims: verified anthropogenic flattening without causal evidence
independent expert validation from model agreement
